text: Given ticket 456 has at least one action, When halopsa_tickets_list_actions(ticket_id=456) is called with no filters, Then the response's items contains only actions for ticket 456, each with id, who, who_type, who_agentid, note, outcome, datetime, new_status, old_status, hiddenfromuser, timetaken, time_taken_minutes, attachment_count, replied_to_action_id present when HaloPSA sent them.
Given ticket 789 exists and has zero actions, When the tool is called for ticket 789, Then items is an empty list and no error is returned.
Given ticket_id=99999999 does not exist in HaloPSA, When the tool is called with that id, Then the tool returns a not_found error naming ticket 99999999, and no call to /Actions is made.

Given exclude_system=true and important_only=true are both passed, When the tool is called, Then the outgoing GET /Actions request includes both excludesys=true and importantonly=true, and no other filter query parameter is present.
Given no optional filters are passed, When the tool is called, Then the outgoing GET /Actions request has none of the 11 filter query parameters set (only ticket_id and count).

Given a ticket with an HTML-formatted note, When the tool is called with include_html_note=true against a live HaloPSA tenant, Then the matching action's note_html is present and non-empty in the response.
steps: With a real HaloPSA sandbox/test tenant (needs a real vendor account -- not available in this environment, per mcp-track.md 2.5 this does not block design or dev), find or create a ticket with an action that has an HTML-formatted note
Call halopsa_tickets_list_actions with that ticket_id and include_html_note=true
Inspect the matching action in the response
expect: The action's note_html field is present and non-empty, and reflects the HTML content of the note.
evidence: needs a real vendor account; not executed in this environment, per mcp-track.md 2.5/'completion standard' item 3 this does not block dev or INT publish.

text: Given a ticket with 25 actions and limit=20, When the tool is called with no offset, Then items has 20 entries, has_more is true, and next_offset is 20; calling again with offset=20 returns the remaining 5 entries with has_more false.
Given no HaloPSA credential headers are sent, When the tool is called, Then it returns the not_configured error envelope, matching every other tool's behavior for the same condition.
Given ticket_id is passed as a non-numeric value (e.g. "abc"), When the tool is called, Then it returns the invalid_argument error envelope rather than forwarding a malformed request to HaloPSA.

Given the live tools/list output after this change, When compared against tests/fixtures/tools_baseline.json by the existing contract-test suite, Then every existing tool still has all of its baseline parameters with none newly required, no tool is renamed, and halopsa_tickets_list_actions appears with ticket_id as its only required parameter.
